description: Stacked changelog across two successive releases. When a changelog already contains a prior release section, generating the next release prepends the new section above the existing content while keeping the configured header at the top only once. The result lists releases newest-first. Input describes a sequence of two release runs over an initially empty changelog; output is the final changelog document containing both release sections in newest-first order.

cases.expected_output:
# Release Notes
### [1.0.2](/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2) (DATE)


### Bug Fixes

* another patch release HASH



### [1.0.1](/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1) (DATE)


### Bug Fixes

* patch release HASH
